node.statement: Block multiplication gives A_0B=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger X). The amplified compressed product acts entrywise on this one supported block, hence A_0 dot B=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger dot X)=E_{11} tensor (h u_Q), using the defining amplified column-Hilbert display. Therefore A_0 dot B-A_0B=E_{11} tensor (h u_Q-X^dagger X), whose norm is exactly ||h u_Q-X^dagger X|| by the canonical operator-space matrix norm.
